root_cause_criterion.obligation: After sc_pkcs15_free_object(obj) frees obj in the while-loop body, obj must not remain equal to the freed pointer before later use.
root_cause_criterion.fix_action: Reallocate obj with calloc(1, sizeof *obj) immediately after the in-loop sc_pkcs15_free_object(obj) call.

nodes.description: decode_entries[i](p15card, obj, &p, &len) returned SC_SUCCESS, so the while-loop body that frees obj executed.
The post-loop sc_pkcs15_free_object(obj) call receives obj, which is stale in the vulnerable run and leads to the obj->type read in sc_pkcs15_free_object.

edges.description: The same obj pointer observed when the decode succeeds is the pointer freed by the in-loop sc_pkcs15_free_object(obj) call.
The obj pointer value after the in-loop free propagates unchanged to the post-loop sc_pkcs15_free_object(obj) call.
